name: The Dark Light
description: A storm, a dark lighthouse, a ship heading for the rocks. A text adventure with seven endings, narrated by the on-board model.

name: Drop
description: Send files and notes between every phone, tablet and laptop on the hotspot, and keep movies for the flight.

name: Cinema
description: Watch the films and shows, and play the music, loaded onto Drop. Every device picks up where it left off.

name: QuickShot
description: An endless feed of the short videos in Drop's QuickShot folder. Swipe, like, comment.

name: Travel Guide
description: All of Wikivoyage, offline. Look up any destination, or ask a question and get an answer from the guide.
